title: Phaedo Consultation Request
description: The query an agent sends to phaedo_consult at a decision point (Phaedo Protocol v0.1 §10.2).

agent_credential.description: RESERVED for v0.3 authenticated agent identity (§10.5 / OQ9). Today `agent_id` is self-asserted; v0.3 will carry a signed per-agent credential here so a subject can scope `agents` honestly. Optional and ignored by v0.1 resolvers — declared now so the v0.3 addition is backward-compatible.

amount.description: Optional numeric stake (e.g. dollar amount) an authored policy's `amount_gt` threshold can match against (§10.5).

action_binding.description: OPTIONAL (§10.2). Binds the consultation to the concrete call the action_descriptor claims to describe. The descriptor is the agent's CLAIM about its action — untrusted input — while this is a commitment to what it will actually invoke. Recorded on the §10.6 receipt so a mismatch is provable, shown to the subject on an escalation, and required by a §10.5 authorization carrying `require_binding` before that rule will relax anything. A structurally invalid binding MUST be rejected with `request_malformed`.

tool_name.description: The tool or function about to be invoked.

arguments_hash.description: Hex or base64url digest over the Section 6 canonical form of the arguments. The arguments themselves MUST NOT be transmitted.

arguments_preview.description: OPTIONAL short human-readable rendering, for display to the subject on an escalation. Advisory only — never a resolution input.

context.description: Free-form situational hints, e.g. { deadline_pressure, evidence_provided: [] }.
